user.title: Gungor Customizations
user.description: Adds the presets and Immich settings to Configure. Wrappers stay in YAML.

init.title: Gungor Customizations
init.description: Press a section's header to open it, again to close it. An empty preset field is not applied. Key and password fields show empty: leave them empty to keep the stored value. Empty Immich address: Immich off.{error}

light_default.name: Light · default (single press, program end)

data_description.templates: Optional. A template here wins over the field above, e.g. brightness_pct: "{{ 30 if is_state('sun.sun','below_horizon') else 100 }}".

light_default.description: A single press turns this on; a program's set rule returns to it.

light_dim.name: Light · dim (double press)

data_description.templates: Optional. A template here wins over the field above, e.g. brightness_pct: "{{ 30 if is_state('sun.sun','below_horizon') else 100 }}".

light_dim.description: Double press: carries only the brightness.

data_description.templates: Optional. A template here wins over the field above, e.g. brightness_pct: "{{ 30 if is_state('sun.sun','below_horizon') else 100 }}".

climate_default.name: Climate · default (program end)

data_description.templates: Optional. A template here wins over the field above, e.g. brightness_pct: "{{ 30 if is_state('sun.sun','below_horizon') else 100 }}".

climate_default.description: A program's set rule returns to this.

cover_default.name: Cover · default (sunrise, sunset, program end)
cover_default.description: Applied at sunrise, sunset and when a program ends.

data.scan_interval: Scan interval (0 = only the sync button)
data.share_albums: Share every album with the others

data_description.users: Add / remove: name and API key per Immich user (Account settings > API keys). A stored key shows empty; leave it empty to keep it.

data_description.home: A new photo without faces, taken outside a trip
data_description.trip: A new photo without faces, taken on a trip

budget_thuis.name: Budget Thuis
budget_thuis.description: Electricity, gas and return delivery: the month so far as sensors. Status: {budget_thuis}. No password: a new login mails you a link to paste on the next page. Empty e-mail: off.

data.new_login: Log in again (mail a new link)

budget_thuis_link.title: Budget Thuis: login link
budget_thuis_link.description: A mail was sent to {email}. Do NOT click the login link: right-click it, copy the link and paste it here. (If you clicked it and the browser stopped at budgetthuis://login_success?code=..., paste that.){error}

options.trash: Move to the trash (30 days to restore)

yaml_ignored.title: gungors: presets/Immich in YAML are ignored
yaml_ignored.description: They are set under Settings > Devices & services > gungors > Configure now. Remove {keys} from YAML.
